role: Senior Software Engineer, through Mindgrub Technologies
dek: ROFO Rewards is the loyalty program for Royal Farms, a large Maryland convenience chain. The work covered the web services behind the rewards app (authentication, scheduled tasks, persistence, cloud functions, Dockerized environments) and a React and Redux admin portal with Jest and Enzyme tests.
short: The ROFO Rewards loyalty program for Royal Farms: web services behind the rewards app and a React and Redux admin portal, Dockerized and tested with Jest and Enzyme. One of my first React applications.
